name: Yngvi
source:
A Svartalfar (dark elf) civilian with a shaggy head, slightly upturned ears, and tan-like deep brown skin. He abandoned the land of his birth and lived by traveling, cheating and stealing, until Loki approached him and made him his servant. 

In order to entangle the Valkyries, he blends in with the Elves of Light and approaches Hildr's army. In public, he acts the part of a good-natured, handsome young man, but in reality, he is a despicable man.

 Believing Loki's words that he will be given the power of a demigod if he can win over the Valkyries, he aims to enter the world of the gods.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150504020622/http://www.matsuri-kikaku.com/matsuri/val2/val2_cha0.html]archived official site[/url]]
